decisions.what: For Linux R1', I used the v1.2.0 method (drop by local ports) instead of socket cgroupv2
decisions.why: Blocklist already explicitly passes the local ports of the denied apps sockets. This allows nftables to just drop by tcp/udp sport/dport uniformly.

decisions.what: For Windows R2', I used netsh advfirewall mapping program to Blocklist::paths.
decisions.why: Windows can block per-PROGRAM directly, I did not need to block local_ports.

decisions.what: Removed panics and indexed bounds directly.
decisions.why: To prevent panics from bad input.
